record_title: Absorbing terms collapse locally finite Schreier ring varieties
provenance: A two-coordinate absorbing-term obstruction for locally finite Schreier varieties, with exact classifications for ring and fixed-field algebra varieties.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Burgin's 1974 homogeneous linear-Omega-algebra theory already supplies residue-field restrictions and zero-multiplication examples; these are prior art. The new claim is the local-finiteness collapse of two-coordinate absorbing terms and the resulting exact ring classification under arbitrary identities. Equivalent implicit coverage in older universal-algebra literature remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
